messages:
maya: Heads-up — getting a few customer escalations reporting p95 latency ~2x after the runtime v12.4 rollout. Canary instance shows p95 up and p99 noisy. Anyone digging in yet?

deploy-bot: Rollout v12.4 -> canary 10% at 2025-11-03T10:28:12Z (id: r-12.4-20251103).
john: I'm on traces. Early look: tail latency spikes correlate with a rise in request queueing time, not GPU compute.
lee: Noted — kernel selector change landed in the runtime patch (commit 9f3b2c). Also we bumped max_batch_size default from 8 -> 16 in the batching service.
sam: Prom queries showing queueing_ms jump around rollout time: 
```
# 1m rate of queued requests (p99)
max_over_time(service_runtime_queue_ms[5m])
```
Graph link: https://prom.redwood/graph?g=queueing_spike (attached).
maya: Can we bisect quickly? Two suspects: kernel selector heuristics and max_batch_size change. If we can repro locally with canary config that'd help.
john: Quick repro curl (send a tight stream of short prompts to hit batching):
```bash
for i in {1..200}; do curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"gpt-small","input":"hi"}' & done
wait
```
Run that against canary and control nodes to compare latency distribution.
lee: Reproduced locally: with max_batch_size=16 we see queueing tail at high concurrency; 8 is fine. Kernel selector chooses a different kernel variant under certain sequence lengths which increases per-call overhead ~3-5ms, but that alone doesn't explain p99 jumps. Combined effects amplify queueing.
infra-bot: Collected canary host logs (/var/log/runtime/canary/*) and core dump snapshots from the timeframe. Upload: s3://redwood-logs/canary/r-12.4-2256789012.zip
support-bot: Customer impact: 3 customers flagged, one on Dedicated saw timeouts/retries. Support notified and offered mitigation: pin to last stable runtime or enable low_latency profile.
sam: Prom excerpts showing queue length per host: 
```
sum by (host) (increase(runtime_queue_length[2m]))
```
Hosts serving canary show 4-5x higher queue growth.
maya: Mitigation options order: 1) Roll back canary to v12.3 for affected compute pool, 2) Reduce max_batch_size on canary to previous default, 3) Force kernel selector to prefer low-overhead kernel. Thoughts?
john: For quick customer relief, rollback the canary in the impacted pool. Reduces blast radius and buys time for bisect.
lee: I can back out the batching default in a config flip (no deploy). Patch snippet: 
```yaml
batcher:
  max_batch_size: 8  # revert to previous
```
That should be low-risk and immediate.
maya: Do the config flip on canary hosts now, test p95, if still bad, roll back.
lee: Flipped config on canary pool -> applying.
deploy-bot: Config change applied to pool canary-1 at 2025-11-03T10:41:05Z.
sam: Initial post-flip numbers — p95 trending down on canary-1 (partial). Still checking p99.
john: Meanwhile I'll run a targeted bisect to identify the kernel selector commit: 
1) checkout v12.4
2) git bisect start v12.3 v12.4
3) apply test harness (tight concurrency load)
4) mark good/bad
Should take ~5-7 iterations.
maya: If bisect points to kernel selector tweak, we can either revert that change or add a fast-path flag for short sequences. If it's batching-only, leave kernel changes and fix batcher defaults.
lee: Bisect update: narrowed down to 9f3b2c -> 3d7a5e range. 3d7a5e introduced faster but higher-overhead kernel for small sequences. I'll open a PR for selector guardrails.
support-bot: Notifying affected customers with ETA for mitigation (config flip done) and offering to pin to 12.3 until rollback completes.
maya: Good work. Postmortem action items: add automatic alerts when queueing_ms p99 doubles post-rollout, make batcher default conservative in canaries, and add canary perf smoke test that hits batching extremes.
john: Agreed. Also adding a tracing span to capture kernel-selection decision time to make cause easier to find next time.
lee: PR created: fix/kernel-selector-guardrails (links to 3d7a5e revert + tests).
deploy-bot: Rollback to v12.3 requested by maya at 2025-11-03T10:52:10Z. Initiating canary rollback on impacted pool.
sam: After rollback p95 back to baseline on all impacted hosts. Monitoring for an hour, will update.
maya: Thanks team — keep this thread updated with bisect results and customer comms. :thumbsup:
